title: Indian Sausage Stir Fry
description: A flavorful and spicy Indian-inspired stir fry made with sausage and hearty vegetables. Best served with basmati rice or naan bread.
instructions: Heat 1 tablespoon of oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the sausage and cook until browned, about 5 minutes.
Add the onion, bell pepper, and tomato. Cook until the vegetables are tender, about 5 minutes.
Add the tomato paste and stir to combine.
Add the stir fry sauce and stir to combine. Cook for an additional 1-2 minutes.
Serve hot over basmati rice or with naan bread.
